lighting_isotropy.metric: 36-bin land-luminance-gradient peak divided by uniform-bin mean after a local separable Lanczos3 reproduction of the 2560 px pipeline derivation; gradients below 12 luminance units excluded
lighting_isotropy.visual_check: Neutral form shading and local ambient occlusion are present; no directional key, cast-shadow field, sun angle, or time-of-day gradient was observed.

median_conifer_crown_final_scale.measurement: Median bounding-box width across 42 isolated dark-green conifer crown components, scaled by 2560/1254. The segmentation can omit lighter branch tips, but a mature-only subset still measures only 70.43 px / 3.38 m at final scale.

buildable_vs_steep_fraction.basis: estimated fraction of non-water land area
buildable_vs_steep_fraction.method: Full-source authoring estimate: broad coherent upper and lower shelf surfaces versus exposed central and eastern basalt walls; remaining land is broken, talus-covered, scrubbed, or densely vegetated.

water_mask.encoding: opaque white water pixels on fully transparent non-water pixels
water_mask.method: Source-pixel chroma and luminance segmentation constrained to the visually inspected full-width painted channel, including the fall and spray; two-source-pixel fringe admission, morphological closure, component filtering, and enclosed-hole filling. The dry northern erosion gully is excluded at its visible color break. The terrain source remained byte-identical.

source_scale_gate_proxy.note: The same blue-leaning fringe classifier was evaluated at proportionally scaled source radii because node.exe is not exposed in this managed shell.

open_risks: Conifer crowns are materially underscale against the required 84-147 px final-canvas range; this raw single-call source cannot be corrected without violating the one-call and untouched-source contract.
The official Node authoring gates were not run because node.exe is not exposed in this managed shell; the 6 px and 48 px fringe results are source-scale reproductions.
Visual seam, composition, and terrain-quality judgment remain owner decisions; mechanical checks do not establish visual acceptance.
